kqVfjBOC1Bc.title: What is one of the riskiest investments in India? #LendingMoney #PersonalFinance #moneymistakes
kqVfjBOC1Bc.description:
What is one of the riskiest investments in India? 😅
Lending money to someone you know! 💸
When they borrow it:
"Bro, I’ll definitely return it next month." 😂
When you ask for it back:
"Bro, just give me a little more time..." 😭
And the most dangerous line:
"We’re family, what’s the problem?" 😂
Lending money isn't just about money.
Sometimes you are also putting your relationship, peace of mind and friendship at risk.
So before lending money, remember one simple rule:
Only lend what you can afford
